245618.Description:
[Start of Your Turn] If a Digimon card with "Unidentified" in its type is in your trash, gain 1 memory.
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon digivolves into "Diaboromon", you may suspend this Tamer to play 1 "Diaboromon" Token without paying its memory cost. (Diaboromon Tokens are level 6 white Digimon with a memory cost of 14, 3000 DP, and are Mega form, Unidentified type, and Unknown attribute.)
245618.Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.

245619.Description:
[Digisorption -2] (When one of your Digimon digivolves into this card from your hand, you may suspend 1 of your Digimon to reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by 2.)
[When Digivolving] Suspend all of your opponent's Tamers.
[All Turns] Your opponent's Tamers don't unsuspend.

245620.Description:
[Main] [Digi-Burst 3] (Trash 3 of this Digimon's Digivolution cards to activate the effect below.)
You may play 1 level 3 purpleDigimon card from your trash wihout paying its memory cost. Any [On Play] effects on Digimon played with this effect don't activate.
245620.Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once per turn] You may delete 1 of your other Digimon to unsuspend this Digimon.

245621.Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When you trash a digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon, gain 1 memory.

245622.Description: [Main] Trigger [De-Digivolve 2] on 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash up to 2 cards from the top of one of your opponent's Digimon. If it has no digivolution cards, or becomes a level 3 Digimon, you can't trash any more cards.)Then, if you have a [Diaboromon] in play, you may play 1 [Diaboromon] Token without paying its memory cost. (Diaborormon Tokens are level 6 white Digimon with a memory cost of 14, 3000 DP, and are Mega form, Unidentified type, and Unknown attribute.)

245623.Description: [Main] Delete 1 of your opponent's unsuspended level 4 Digimon and 1 of your opponent's unsuspended level 5 Digimon.

245624.Description:
[Start of Your Turn] If your opponent has a suspended Digimon in play, gain 2 memory.
[Your Turn] When you attack with a level 5 green Digimon, you may suspend this Tamer to reveal 3 cards from the top of your deck. You may digivolve 1 green level 6 Digimon card among them onto the attacking Digimon without paying its memory cost. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
245624.Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.

245625.Description:
[When Digivolving] Both players trash the top 5 cards of their decks.
[On Deletion] If you have a Tamer in play, you may play 1 level 6 Digimon card with [Gallantmon] in its name from your hand or trash without paying its memory cost.

245626.Description: [When Digivolving] If a Digimon card with [Garurumon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect to the bottom of its owner's deck. Trash all of the digivolution cards of that Digimon.

245627.Description: [When Digivolving] If a Digimon card with [MetalGreymon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less.
245627.Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Omnimon] or [Greymon] (other than [DoruGreymon], [BurningGreymon], or [DexDoruGreymon]) in its name, it gets +2000 DP.

245628.Description:
[On Play] You may play 1 "Agumon" or "Gabumon" from your hand without paying its memory cost.
[Main] When digivolving one of your Digimon into a Digimon card in your hand with "Garurumon", "Omnimon", or "Greymon" (other than "DoruGreymon", "BurningGreymon", or "DexDoruGreymon") in its name, you may suspend this Tamer to reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by 1.
245628.Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.

245629.Description: Your [Shoutmon] can digivolve into this card in your hand for a memory cost of 4, ignoring this card's digivolution requirements.
245629.Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Blitz], it gains [Security Attack +1]. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)

245630.Description: [On Play] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains [Security Attack -1] (This Digimon checks 1 fewer security cards) until the end of your opponent's next turn.

245631.Description:
[Opponent's Turn] When an opponent's Digimon moves from the breeding area to the battle area, it gains [Security Attack -3] (This Digimon checks 3 fewer security cards) for the turn.
[Your Turn] All fo your opponent's Security Digimon get -3000 DP.

245632.Description:
[Start of Your Turn] If your opponent has a Digimon with no digivolution cards in play, gain 2 memory.
[Your Turn] When you attack with a blue Digimon, you may suspend this Tamer to trash up to 2 digivolution cards from the bottom of 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
245632.Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.

245633.Description:

[Your Turn] All of your Digimon with "Omnimon" in their names gain [[Security Attack +1]. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
245633.Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.

245634.Description:
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon digivolves, you may suspend this Tamer to trigger [Draw 1] (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
[All Turns] All level 3 Digimon gain "[When Attacking] Lose 1 memory."
245634.Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.

245635.Description:
[Main] [Digi-Burst 1] (Trash 1 of this Digimon's digivolution cards to activate the effect below.)
• Reveal the top card of your deck. Add it to your hand if it's a green Digimon card. Otherwise, place it at the bottom of your deck.

245636.Description: [When Digivolving] If a Digimon card with [Greymon] in its name (other than [DoruGreymon], [BurningGreymon], or [DexDoruGreymon]) is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with [Blocker].
245636.Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less.

245637.Description: [Your Turn] While a Digimon card with [WereGarururmon] in its name is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, this Digimon gains [Jamming]. (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
245637.Inherited Effect: [All Turns] While this Digimon has [Garurumon] or [Omnimon] in its name, it gets +1000 DP.

245639.Description: [Main] Trash the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards to the bottom of its owner's deck.

245640.Description: [On Deletion] Return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon to the bottom of its owner's deck. Trash all of the digivolution cards of that Digimon.

245641.Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] If your opponent has a Digimon with no digivolution cards in play, this Digimon gains [Security Attack +1]. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)

245643.Description: [When Digivolving] If this Digimon has [Agumon] in its digivolution cards, gain 1 memory.

245649.Description:
[Main] For each Digimon you have in play, activate the effect below.
• 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn.
